github_pages.control: Route the custom hostname through the edge and track direct Pages reachability as accepted residual risk.

preferred_controls: provider authenticated origin pull or mTLS
edge-overwritten high-entropy origin header validated by the origin
required_origin_behavior: Reject missing or invalid edge identity before application routing.
Overwrite, never append, the origin-auth header at the edge.
Disable direct public ingress where the hosting platform permits it.
Rotate the credential after suspected disclosure and record the rotation.
Return Cache-Control: no-store on authentication, admin, checkout, webhook, and personalized responses.
dynamic_origins.failure_mode: Fail closed at the dynamic origin. A provider control-plane outage must not make direct origin ingress public.
